description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Median Sale Price' headline figure in the
Market section.

Latest median sale price for the suburb, by house and unit (AUD). Each value is the latest
observation we hold and carries its own date (`house_as_of`, `unit_as_of`);
`as_of` is the newer of the two. Dates are never later than today.

**Price: 6¢ per call.**
